anchors.identity: One dark segmented sky-repair worker keeps the accepted silhouette and long red cape.
anchors.wardrobe_props: The amber repair light remains in the tower-side hand and the thin safety cable remains attached at the lower torso.
anchors.space_direction: The steel tower stays left and the worker stays screen-right on the accepted exterior camera side.
anchors.light_material: Cold storm light, warm fissure edges, dull wet steel, and weighted red oilcloth retain their accepted response.

protected.state: The same dark climbing silhouette, attached long red cape, amber hand light, and torso cable remain visible.
The tower stays left, storm sky stays right, and the exterior camera side remains stable.
Dull wet steel, the heavy cape, and cold camera-left storm light remain stable.

transitions.subject: the cable-suspended worker
transitions.from_state: the body hangs almost horizontal and moves screen-right away from the tower
transitions.transition: taut cable tension curves the body back as both boots reach the outer rib
transitions.to_state: both boots plant on the tower while the cable remains taut
transitions.proof: both boots visibly contact the outer rib before the repair begins

transitions.subject: the amber repair light and vertical fissure
transitions.from_state: the bright vertical fissure remains open beside the recovered worker
transitions.transition: the hand light contacts the seam and amber closure travels upward
transitions.to_state: one continuous repaired steel edge replaces the opening
transitions.proof: the visible fissure closes from the contact point into one uninterrupted edge

transitions.subject: the storm sky behind the repaired seam
transitions.from_state: cold gray cloud remains behind the open fissure
transitions.transition: the completed repair motivates a restrained pale brightening
transitions.to_state: pale dawn rests behind the sealed tower edge
transitions.proof: the final frame shows both the sealed seam and restrained pale dawn

checkpoints.state: The opening matches the horizontal worker screen-right of the tower, taut lower cable, trailing cape, amber hand light, and open fissure.
checkpoints.visual_test: Worker silhouette, cape, tool hand, cable direction, tower side, fissure, and storm light match the accepted endpoint.

checkpoints.state: The accepted screen-right swing continues briefly as cable tension curves the worker back toward the tower.
checkpoints.visual_test: Body inertia, cable tension, cape drag, and the return arc form one continuous motion.

checkpoints.state: Both boots plant on the outer rib and the amber hand light touches the vertical fissure.
checkpoints.visual_test: Two boot contacts and one clear hand-light-to-seam contact are simultaneously visible.

checkpoints.state: Amber closure travels upward from the contact point until one repaired steel edge remains and pale dawn appears behind it.
checkpoints.visual_test: The opening visibly closes before restrained pale dawn becomes readable behind the sealed edge.

checkpoints.state: The worker holds both boots on the tower beside the sealed seam as restrained pale dawn rests behind it.
checkpoints.visual_test: The final frame proves boot contact, taut cable, attached cape, sealed seam, stable tool, and pale dawn.
